newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares eyeing Wall Street for direction.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares eyeing Wall Street for direction.

text.p: Share prices opened lower on Monday and brokers said the focus would be on Wall Street.
At 0830 GMT the general index had fallen 0.29 percent to 3,063.34 in light turnover of 212 million crowns.
With no major statistics ahead brokers would be looking at the open of Wall Street for guidance. U.S. markets were closed on Friday for Independence Day.
Players were also waiting for Motorola's earnings report due on Tuesday. Telecoms group and index heavyweight Ericsson edged down 0.5 crown to 315 in the meantime.
Insurance company Skandia jumped seven crowns to 315, testing record territory. Kleinwort Benson said its target price for the share was 450 by the beginning of 1999.
Vehicle maker Volvo fell one crown to 205.5.
